test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: _______, the first 'made in India' Petascale supercomputer that was deployed at IIT Roorkee in March 2022, has a supercomputing capacity of 1.66 Petaflops.
solution:
The correct answer is __**PARAM Ganga.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• A Made in India **Petascale Supercomputer** named** "PARAM Ganga" **with a **1.66 Petaflop** (Peta Floating-Point Operations Per Second) supercomputing capacity has been deployed at IIT (Indian Institute of Technology) **Roorkee**, Uttarakhand, as of March 7, 2022.
 
• **Chairman of the Board** of Governors at IIT Roorkee, **B.V.R. Mohan Reddy,** officially opened this country's supercomputer facility.
 
• The National Supercomputing Mission's Phase 2 build strategy included the **design **and **commissioning **of **PARAM Ganga **by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) (NSM).
 
• This organisation is supported by the **Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** that IIT Roorkee and C-DAC signed for the **construction **of a **supercomputer **that includes crucial parts such as **motherboards **for servers and direct contact liquid cooling data centers, among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Characteristics **of PARAM Ganga:

 
 
• Only in **India **are its **components **and **software stack **produced and assembled.
 
• It is a **brand-new High-Performance Computing (HPC)** facility that will quicken** research and development (R&D) **efforts in interdisciplinary science and engineering fields to address challenging issues of both global and national significance.
 
• Additionally, it provides computing resources to the IIT Roorkee user community and nearby** academic institutions.**
